title: Menu bar panel redesign
brief: Redesign the Dev Mission Control menu bar panel so it answers 'where was I and what needs attention?' at a glance: honest severity tiers, one global source notice instead of per-card source rows, and a fast path back into work.

artboards.title: Triage inbox
artboards.tradeoff: Fastest to scan for what is blocked; 'where you left off' only appears after expanding a row

artboards.title: Resume board
artboards.tradeoff: Best for picking up work (Engram summary + last commit + Resume); severity is secondary and cards take more height

artboards.title: Split console
artboards.tradeoff: Everything in one place, no separate detail window; a wide 760 px popover covers more of the screen
